recentItems.title: Sonu Sood SLAMS student housing crisis after Delhi Building Collapse, suggests hostels on Govt land
recentItems.description:
Sonu Sood has raised concerns over the student housing crisis in Delhi following the tragic collapse of a five-storey building that claimed seven lives. The actor questioned whether students moving to the capital for education are being provided with safe and affordable places to stay. Sood suggested identifying vacant government land near universities to build student hostels. He also proposed giving universities additional permissions to create more on-campus accommodation. Here's what Sonu Sood said and why his comments have sparked attention after the Delhi building collapse.

recentItems.title: Mirzapur: The Movie's 2nd post-credit scene REMOVED; Makers save big twist for Part 2!
recentItems.description:

The makers have allegedly decided to save the unreleased sequence for Mirzapur The Movie Part 2, as revealing it now could have reduced its impact in the sequel. The film's existing post-credit scene already teases a major conflict involving Guddu Pandit, Munna Tripathi and Bablu Pandit. So, what could the second unreleased scene reveal? Here's everything about the makers' decision and what it could mean for the future of the Mirzapur franchise.
